novel:
Create a single production app icon for Amber Novel, a premium Chinese literary writing application. Square 1024x1024 opaque image, artwork fills the entire canvas; absolutely no mockup, no external frame, no pre-rounded icon boundary, no typography or letters.

Art direction: a beautifully designed, minimal sculptural PAPER RIBBON that becomes a writing gesture. One continuous warm ivory ribbon forms a confident flowing diagonal loop in the upper half, then folds into a tapered fountain-pen nib in the lower-right half. The overall silhouette is elegant, compact and immediately memorable, like an expertly folded paper sculpture, not a literal stationary illustration. A single tiny slit in the nib makes writing legible without adding a separate pen. Aim for the sophistication of a real independently designed iOS app icon and a modern literary publisher.

Composition: central sculptural mark occupies 66-70% of the canvas, generous clean breathing space. Strong visual weight in the center, two or three broad folds maximum, exquisitely controlled curves and slightly softened physical edges. The folded paper has subtle thickness, buttery ivory satin-matte material, delicate warm occlusion at overlapping folds, soft studio light from upper left. Beautiful curved edges and surfaces, no fake grunge, no tiny decorative details.

Background: uninterrupted rich muted cinnabar/terracotta, approximately #BF4C35, with an almost imperceptible warm lighting gradient, sophisticated rather than loud. Soft close contact shadows create restrained tactile depth, no drop-shadow halo, no floating platform. Overall warm editorial, quietly creative, not corporate productivity clipart.

Constraints: no Chinese text, no letter monogram, no border, no seal, no stars/sparkles, no orbit circles, no pile of rectangular pages, no flat stock icon, no neon, no exaggerated glossy plastic. One distinct crafted symbol only. It must remain clear at 64 pixels.
deepread:
Create a single production app icon for Amber Deep Read, a premium Chinese in-depth reading app. A square 1024x1024 opaque image with the background reaching all four edges. No mockup, no exterior frame, no pre-rounded icon boundary, absolutely no letters or text.

Art direction: one beautifully sculpted OPEN BOOK made from two continuous broad cinnabar paper ribbons. Two generous curved pages rise from a central valley and curl gently outward at their outer edges; subtle folded undersides create depth. Seen from an elevated frontal three-quarter angle, the book silhouette is unmistakable, broad and calm, like an editorial paper sculpture with superbly refined curves. The upper page edges form two flowing gentle arches; the bottom edge converges into a clean book spine. Two or three substantial surfaces per side, not stacks of thin sheets. Make the page shapes elegant and designed, not a generic book stock icon.

It belongs to a matched app-icon family with a cream folded writing ribbon on a terracotta field: matching satin-matte paper material, gentle physical thickness, controlled contact shadows, upper-left studio lighting, beautiful warm occlusion under curling pages. This reading icon reverses the relationship: a rich muted cinnabar paper sculpture (#BF4C35) on a warm ivory background (#F7F1E7). Cinnabar folds shade naturally into deeper brick tones, no orange-gold metallic edges.

Composition: the single open-book sculpture is centered, occupies around 65-70% of the canvas, with generous breathing room and a clear silhouette at 64 pixels. Restrained tactile depth, almost imperceptible paper texture. Pure uninterrupted ivory backdrop with an extremely gentle lighting gradient. Clean, contemporary literary publisher aesthetic, quietly creative and sophisticated.

No seal, no framed character, no star, no sparkles, no orbit rings, no magnifier, no separate props, no tiny printed page lines, no flower or butterfly, no pedestal, no elaborate environment, no glossy plastic, no thick black outline. One strong crafted form only.
deepreadRefinement: Preserve the sculptural open-book design; reduce sculpture about 12%, keep centered, slightly smooth texture, retain ivory background and cinnabar folds.
